title: Kafka Connect Task Failed State
dataSources: Kafka Connect REST status (`kafkaconnect:status`), worker logs (`kafkaconnect:worker`), and JMX source/sink metrics (`kafkaconnect:jmx`).
app: Kafka Connect REST API (`/connectors`, `/connectors/{name}/status`) via HEC scripted inputs; Connect worker logs and JMX metrics.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=kafkaconnect:status
| stats latest(connector_state) as conn_state, sum(eval(task_state="FAILED")) as failed_tasks, count as total_tasks by connector
| where failed_tasks>0 OR conn_state="FAILED"
| sort - failed_tasks
description: Polls the Kafka Connect status API and flags connectors with any task in FAILED state, which stops that partition of the data flow until restarted.
value: A single failed task silently halts part of a streaming pipeline; status polling catches it because failed tasks are not auto-restarted by default.
implementation: Poll `/connectors/{name}/status` into HEC; schedule every 5 minutes and alert on any FAILED task for a production connector.
visualization: Table of connector by failed tasks, status panel.
grandmaExplanation: We watch the streaming data connectors and flag any part that has failed, since it will stay stopped until someone restarts it.
